meta.title: Order Activity records a vendor submitting a bid
gaps: Verify the entry names the specific vendor who submitted the bid.
Verify the exact date and time of the bid submission.
Verify all activity lines are in chronological order and that nothing earlier is missing.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify the entry names the specific vendor who submitted the bid.; Verify the exact date and time of the bid submission.; Verify all activity lines are in chronological order and that nothing earlier is missing.

steps.note: Create a test event for the activity scenario.
Apply the first available template before adding line items.
Add one product for the vendor to quote.
Complete the pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite one QA vendor to submit the bid.
Publish the event before the vendor bids.
Confirm the event reached a real project page.
Have a QA vendor submit a bid through the vendor portal.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Open the stage's Order Activity drawer as the buyer.
Confirm the Order Activity drawer is visible.
Verify the activity history retains an earlier event-creation entry.
Verify the history contains an activity entry for the vendor submission.
